narrative.details:
You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!

<The King sobs.>

And now she's gone, adventurer!

I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!

Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... find him! I want answers!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 54 to 59, 36,500 XP in all.

quests.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
quests.objectiveText: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
quests.objectiveText: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics.

quests.name: Kharan Mighthammer
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer. The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

quests.name: The Bearer of Bad News
quests.objectiveText: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
quests.objectiveText: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

quests.name: The Princess's Surprise
quests.objectiveText: Return to Ironforge and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard.
